name: BGE v2 real-frame qualification thresholds, v1
declared_before: any real-frame qualification data for BGE v2 is analysed; values fixed by the coordinator on 2026-11-11; amended (a)-(c) by the coordinator the same day, before any real frame was seen
provenance: Threshold values and their provenance tags (in brackets in the coordinator's table) are fixed by the coordinator. Minimum-data rules marked min_data_provenance='infrastructure default' are the qualification infrastructure's choice, fixed with this file. A failed criterion is reported as failed and is never relaxed after a hold-out run. Amended (a)-(c) on 2026-11-11 before any real frame was analysed; predeclared_utc is the time of the amendment.

variant_roles.sep_v2: SEP v2: masked_local_v2 noise, dip_annulus_v2 gate, regroup_deblended (spec section 4)
variant_roles.legacy_background: legacy backend with the v2 gate: the comparator for gate-independent background criteria (R5-R16) and the subject of the pure gate criterion R17
variant_roles.legacy_gate: legacy backend with the v1 gate: the comparator of the pure gate criterion R17

aggregation.rule: each criterion is evaluated per hold-out night; overall pass iff at least one hold-out night is evaluable and every evaluable night passes; fail if any evaluable night fails; not_evaluable when no night is evaluable
aggregation.frames: light frames of the night unless the criterion says otherwise; darks/bias calibrate s0 (development nights only) and mask hot pixels (same night)

criteria_per_night_statistics.R11: median over dark trials, differential truth

constants.cfz: 4 * lambda * N^2 (full width), N = focal_ratio of the beam the focuser moves (native f/3.95 for the Z114 also with a Barlow in the drawtube), converted to steps with focuser_stepsize_um
constants.s0_rule: s0(method) = median over development-night dark and bias frames (same analysis input representation) of the per-frame robust std (1.4826 MAD) of the pull on the method's source-masked, hot-pixel-masked sky; s0 = 1.0 and flagged s0_uncalibrated when fewer than 2 such frames exist

criteria.title: pull mean
criteria.subject: sep_v2
criteria.statistic: per-night median over light frames of |mean z| (z = (I - B_hat)/R_hat on the source-masked sky; mean over |z| <= 5)

criteria.title: pull robust std
criteria.subject: sep_v2
criteria.statistic: per-night median over light frames of the pull robust std (1.4826 MAD)

criteria.title: pull tail
criteria.subject: sep_v2
criteria.statistic: per-night median over light frames of P(|z| > 5) after hot-pixel masking

criteria.title: difference-pull std
criteria.subject: sep_v2
criteria.statistic: per-night median over consecutive pairs within repeat groups of the robust std of (I1 - I2)/sqrt(R1^2 + R2^2)

criteria.title: negated-residual false detections
criteria.subject: sep_v2
criteria.statistic: night-pooled rate: (sum over the night's light frames of detections on -(I - B_hat) with the common reference detector) / (sum of usable Mpx); subject and comparator on the same frames
criteria.aggregation_within_night: pooled over light frames (not a median of per-frame rates)

criteria.title: injection completeness
criteria.subject: sep_v2
criteria.statistic: per-night completeness per S/N bin (identical injected images for both methods)
criteria.rhs: comparator - margin in every bin with lower edge >= min_bin_lower_edge

criteria.title: injection HFR bias
criteria.subject: sep_v2
criteria.statistic: per-night median over accepted injected stars at S/N >= 20 of (HFR_method - HFR_truth)/HFR_truth; HFR_truth = the noiseless, isolated injected stamp measured with the daemon-equivalent crop estimator: zero sky, crop = clamp(2 x the bounding-box extent of stamp pixels above 5 x the frame sky sigma (median reference R_hat), 32, 128) px placed by ml.labels.psf_measure.rust_extract_crop, HFR by ml.labels.psf_measure.rust_compute_hfr_with_sky (Python twin of ClassicalFocusSolver::compute_hfr_with_sky) with level 0 and sigma = frame sky sigma
criteria.observation_not_criterion: R7-obs (same statistic against the total-flux HFR of the injected profile)

criteria.title: injection flux bias
criteria.subject: sep_v2
criteria.statistic: per-night median relative aperture-flux error (r = max(4, 3 HFR_true)) at S/N >= 20

criteria.title: injection centroid error
criteria.subject: sep_v2
criteria.statistic: per-night median distance of the matched detection from the injected position at S/N >= 20

criteria.title: background under injected stars
criteria.subject: sep_v2
criteria.statistic: per-night median over injected stars of mean(B_hat_inj - B_hat_orig) within max(2, 2 HFR_true) in units of R_hat_orig

criteria.title: dark + injection
criteria.subject: sep_v2
criteria.statistic: per night: median over the night's dark trials of |median over usable pixels of (B_hat(D+G+S) - B_true)| / sigma_D, with the differential truth B_true = B_hat(D) + G of the same method (the dark's own level cancels); and median over trials completed by both of the RMSE, subject <= comparator
criteria.aggregation_within_night: median over dark trials (each dark x each simulated sky model)

criteria.title: status-failure rate
criteria.subject: sep_v2
criteria.statistic: per-night fraction of light frames whose level or noise is not measured (or the method failed)

criteria.title: HFR repeatability
criteria.subject: sep_v2
criteria.statistic: per night: median over repeat groups (>= 3 frames with an HFR, both methods) of the frame-HFR CV; subject median <= ratio x comparator median (ratio of medians, not median of ratios)

criteria.title: focus repeatability
criteria.subject: sep_v2
criteria.statistic: per night with >= 4 successful sweep fits: std (ddof 1) of the hyperbola p0 over sweeps

criteria.title: focus agreement
criteria.subject: sep_v2
criteria.statistic: per-night median over sweeps fitted by both of |p0_subject - p0_comparator|

criteria.title: V-curve residual RMS
criteria.subject: sep_v2
criteria.statistic: per night: median over sweeps fitted by both methods of the hyperbola residual RMS (px); subject median <= ratio x comparator median

criteria.title: sweep coverage, pure gate change (live default backend)
criteria.subject: legacy_background
criteria.statistic: per-night fraction of sweep frames (excluding moved_during_exposure and verification frames) with a frame HFR: rust_legacy__g2 vs rust_legacy__g1 on the same frames

criteria.title: sweep coverage, SEP v2
criteria.subject: sep_v2
criteria.statistic: per-night fraction of sweep frames (excluding moved_during_exposure and verification frames) with a frame HFR for rust_sep__n2g2; no comparator

observations.title: injection HFR bias vs the total-flux truth (observation, not a criterion)
observations.statistic: per-night median relative HFR error of accepted injected stars at S/N >= 20 against the total-flux half radius of the injected profile inside its render radius (ml.eval.bge.scenarios.numerical_hfr); includes the estimator's aperture definition, reported only

amendments.by: coordinator, before any real frame is seen
amendments.change: R7 truth = HFR of the noiseless injected stamp measured with the daemon-equivalent crop estimator (zero sky; crop = clamp(2 x extent of pixels above 5 x frame sky sigma, 32, 128); ml.labels.psf_measure.rust_compute_hfr_with_sky). The total-flux-truth bias is kept as observation R7-obs. Threshold values unchanged.

amendments.by: coordinator, before any real frame is seen
amendments.change: R17 is a pure gate change on the live default backend: subject rust_legacy__g2 vs comparator rust_legacy__g1 (>= 0.90 and >= comparator). New R17b: rust_sep__n2g2 coverage >= 0.90, no comparator. The mixed SEP-v2-vs-legacy-g1 pairing is dropped.

amendments.by: coordinator, before any real frame is seen
amendments.change: Accepted and stated explicitly: R5 night-pooled rate; R11 median over trials with differential truth B_true = B_hat(dark) + G; R13 median over repeat groups and R16 median over sweeps (ratio of medians).
